not_claimed: 非地下体内无条件贯通真值 (not unconditional subsurface/in-rock connectivity ground truth)
非水力连通与非渗透率结论 (not hydraulic connectivity or permeability)
非直接观测边界边均标记 ASSUMED_NOT_OBSERVED 且不计入直接观测支持

uncertainty_model.discrete_modes_mechanism: Stratum STANDARD_EXT_TILT: 2x3 modes combining f1 radial/planar boundary extension (1.00x vs 1.15x) and f2 exact Pythagorean dip tilt (0 vs +/-3.95 deg).
uncertainty_model.parameter_t_meaning: Shared dimensionless residual-displacement parameter t in [-1, 1] translating interior fractures rigidly along their fitted plane normals
uncertainty_model.residual_source: Perozzo 2024 published xlsx plane-fit residuals: sigma_i = MeanAbsError_i + StDevAbsError_i
uncertainty_model.velocity_formula: v_i = sign_i * k * sigma_i * n_i for interior fractures (anchor fractures f_A, f_B fixed at v=0)

tier1_exact_source_lift.method: Exact Fraction(raw_decimal_string) lift of published xlsx Xcenter/Ycenter/Zcenter/Radius/Nx/Ny/Nz and DXF trace vertices
